description: Four glassy wings over a body like a snapped twig. Shaken loose from whatever swamp thing you flattened.
lore: The body is a stick. Not a figure of speech, and it is why the fraud is so easy: glue four wings onto [[items/crooked_twig|a twig]] and you have twenty-two gold where you had five. Check the sockets. A real one carries four small raised collars in the shell, and you can find them with a thumbnail in the dark. Everybody in that market knows who makes the fakes. She is very good. Everybody buys hers anyway, because at twenty-two gold a fake with four real wings on it is still four real wings, and she has never once denied a thing.
gm_notes: A fraud the market has priced in and stopped resenting. The socket check is real; the forger is unnamed and available for any scene wanting a cheerful crook.
